encounters.weakness: Neural Pulse Rifle (low-frequency burst disrupts data shielding) — reduces enemy shield effectiveness by 60% for 3 seconds. Requires direct fire to activate.
Signal Jammer Module (emits a 4.2 GHz pulse that disrupts AI-7's network logic). Must be activated while player is within 3m of enemy. Module overheats after 2 uses.

Fragmented Signal Probe (must be activated directly on the AI's central node. The probe emits a unique harmonic frequency that reveals the AI's hidden identity — the probe unlocks the 'true signal' that disables the core's defense protocol.)
Kinetic Pulse (player weapon) - 30% damage reduction, causes system overload on hit. Overload triggers a brief data burst that reveals hidden paths and activates nearby drones (chaotic spawns).

Neural Fragment (pickup from first encounter) - When used within 2 seconds of enemy contact, causes a full system purge. AI-9 explodes into data fragments (50% health reduction). However, using the fragment during combat causes a 4-second cooldown on all player abilities. If fragment is not used, AI-9 gains +50% shield and spawns 3 drones (each with 80 health).

Neural Fragment (pickup from first encounter) — Must be activated *directly* on the enemy. When used, it forces a 5-second vulnerability window where Vox-7 is immune to all damage and its attacks freeze. However, if the fragment is used outside of this window, it triggers a self-replication phase, creating 2 mirror copies of Vox-7 (each with 600 health).

Neon Core (data surge mode) — overloads the Sentinel's corrupted data matrix, causing it to glitch and collapse. Requires player to use the Neon Core in its 'emission burst' mode (activation in combat).

Corrupted Data Shard — when activated via the player's Artificer skill, it causes a neural feedback loop that overloads the Enforcer's central processor. The effect lasts 3 seconds and reduces Enforcer's AI response time by 40%.

Static Key — when used during the player's 'Data Fracture' ability, it emits a 7.3Hz pulse that disrupts the Echo's core. This triggers a vulnerability that reduces health by 30% and causes it to emit a fragmented form (a mirrored self) that is immune to normal attacks. The key must be used *during* the pulse to trigger the effect. If not used, the Echo becomes invulnerable and the fight ends in failure.
Chrono-Spike (when used in slow motion, it triggers a delayed feedback loop that causes Glitch-9 to stutter and freeze for 2 seconds, revealing its weak point).

The 'Loop Fragment' pickup. When the player activates a time loop (using Loop Fragment), the Drone's movement becomes erratic and its attack pattern is delayed by 1.5 seconds. The player can then attack during the delay to land a critical hit (3x damage).

The 'Stutter Pulse' pickup. When the Stutter Pulse is active, the enemy's time flow becomes unstable. It appears to move in reverse frames for 0.5 seconds. The player can then attack during this reverse phase and gain a 50% critical damage multiplier (max 500 damage).
Corrosive Syringe (weapon-based weakness: causes internal acid burn and short-circuiting in its nanite core).

Neural Echo Shard (pickup from previous encounter). When activated, the drone's internal bio-circuitry destabilizes, causing it to freeze mid-movement and become vulnerable for 3 seconds. Must be used in a specific phase (during 'pulse cycle').

Glowing Vial of Forgotten Elements (pickup from prior encounter). When the vial is used at 100% charge, Synth-9's core frequency collapses into static, rendering it vulnerable to alchemical bursts. The vial must be used in direct visual contact with the AI's projection screen. If the vial is missing or uncharged, the enemy evolves into a form with phase-shifting armor and 50% increased damage, making defeat impossible without external aid (e.g., external power source — not available).
Neon-Splice Plasma Pistol (overheats, deals 120 damage when fully charged; 15% chance to ignite adjacent drones on hit).
inventory: Neon-Splice Plasma Pistol (rare, high-damage, overheats rapidly)

encounters.weakness: Charged Overheat Core (COC) — when used, reduces Siphon Walker's regeneration by 50% and causes it to lose 40% health in a 3-second burst. Only usable once per fight. Cannot be used if player health drops below 70%.
inventory: Neon-Splice Plasma Pistol (rare, high-damage, overheats rapidly)

encounters.weakness: Neural Dampener (ND) — when used at full charge during the boss fight, the Ghost Network's network pulses are disrupted. For 12 seconds, it is vulnerable to all damage, and the player gains a 150% damage multiplier to the Neon-Splice Plasma Pistol. This must be used within 30 seconds of the boss spawning. Failure results in a 30-second vulnerability and a 50% health reduction (cannot be recovered without restarting).
inventory: Neon-Splice Plasma Pistol (rare, high-damage, overheats rapidly)

encounters.weakness: Lightning (generated by Sky-Whip). Faint zaps cause it to misfire and lose control, dropping to 10% health in 3 seconds if hit by 2 lightning bursts.

Rain (summoned via Sky-Whip). When hit by a rain blast, it emits a loud giggle and becomes confused for 5 seconds, during which it throws confetti instead of attacking. If it giggles twice, it drops its tools and becomes vulnerable.

Confetti Cannon (must be used once during the fight). When the Confetti Cannon is fired, the god emits a high-pitched, cartoonish 'BEEP-BOOP' sound, turns purple, and becomes vulnerable to all attacks for 10 seconds. This is the only way to break its immunity to storms.
The Resonance Gauntlet (harmonic pulses disrupt the Phantom's bio-organic field).
